title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
blurb: TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR — a rhythm borrowed from the Indonesian sahur tradition, where drummers walk the streets before dawn during Ramadan waking people for the pre-fast meal. The internet took that centuries-old wake-up call, attached an AI-generated wooden creature to it, and installed the result on every For You page on Earth. The drum pattern is relentless by design — it was built to wake people up — which is exactly why it refuses to leave your head. One of the founding characters of the Italian brainrot universe.
origin: From Indonesian sahur drum-calling tradition; became a cornerstone Italian brainrot character.
